decision: Approve the board-sticky-side convention for the optional sticky side column of an editorial board.

evidence.interpretation: The owner approved the naming convention in gate 3 of the NotesBoard v0.1 plan. The whole-file plan SHA-256 is f70605329effcc833da4fa9f5e274df43525651321bdd2af45af85d40b034569; the exact entry text is in section 5. Not native review authority.

convention.name: sticky
convention.meaning: Whether an editorial board's side column uses sticky positioning when its layout permits.
convention.whenToUse: Request sticky positioning for the side column of a board, subject to its layout boundary.
convention.avoid: Do not use for scroll state, a generic fixed header, or an uncontrolled scroll listener.
